name: Jason AI
tagline: Jason AI is a B2B sales assistant built into the Reply.io platform that handles outreach, personalizes messages at scale, and follows up with leads automatically. Sales teams use it to run multi-channel prospecting sequences across email, LinkedIn, and other channels, with AI personalizing each message based on prospect data rather than sending identical templates. It handles the high-volume prospecting work that takes significant time for human SDRs, letting them focus on conversations with interested prospects.
